description_excerpt: Job Description POSITION OVERVIEW: • The Maintenance Technician is responsible for ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of production equipment, utility systems, and facility infrastructure to support manufacturing and business operations. • This role performs both preventive and corrective maintenance activities to maintain equipment performance, minimize downtime, and ensure compliance with GMP, Safety, Environmental, and Quality standards.
